The incidence of [[atrieflimren]] per 1,000 inhabitants varies significantly across the five Danish regions, revealing a consistent geographic divide between the highest and lowest rates over nearly a decade of tracking. Across the reporting periods from 2016/2017 through 2024/2025, [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]] consistently records the highest incidence rates in the country. It peaked at 4.7 per 1,000 inhabitants in 2016/2017 [^src1] and, despite a gradual decline, remained the national leader at 4.1 in 2024/2025 [^src2].

Conversely, [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]] consistently reports the lowest incidence of the condition, acting as a clear outlier on the lower end. Starting at 3.6 in 2016/2017 [^src1], the rate in the capital region fell to a low of 2.9 in 2020/2021 [^src1] before stabilizing at 3.2 in the most recent 2024/2025 period [^src2]. Most other regions frequently maintain rates at or above 4.0. For instance, [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] and [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]] regularly hover around this mark, with Nordjylland reaching 4.1 in 2024/2025 [^src2] and Syddanmark matching that figure in the same year [^src2].

At the national level, the overall incidence in [[danmark|Danmark]] experienced a slight downward trend before plateauing. The national rate dropped from 3.9 in 2016/2017 [^src1] to 3.5 in 2019/2020 [^src1], and has since remained relatively flat, holding steady at 3.7 from 2022/2023 through 2024/2025 [^src2]. Meanwhile, [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]] tracks closely with the national average, showing a slight upward trajectory in recent years, moving from 3.3 in 2018/2019 [^src1] to 3.8 in 2023/2024 [^src2] before dipping slightly to 3.7 in 2024/2025 [^src2].

- "Incidens af atrieflimren i opgørelsesperioden/året for Danmark er 3,3 pr. 1000 indbyggere" — see [[incidence-rate|Incidence Rate]] ([[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden — Hovedstaden]], [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland — Sjælland]], [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark — Syddanmark]], [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland — Midtjylland]], [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland — Nordjylland]]) [^src28]

- "Region Sjælland har iværksat en intern undersøgelse af registrerings- og dataflow-fejl i forbindelse med indikator 8" — see [[quality-improvement-action|Quality Improvement Action]] ([[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland — Sjælland]]) [^src40]
